body.name: Inherited observed-data Rao--Blackwell seed estimator
body.construction: On the seed branch, set \[\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{seed}}=\sum_{i\in V_n}w_i(Z;G)Y_i-\frac1n\sum_{i\in V_n}\frac{\mathbf 1\{Z|_{N_G[i]}=0\}}{\pi_i^{(0)}(G)}Y_i.\] The conditional multiplicity weights \(w_i(Z;G)\) integrate out the unobserved seed tuple.
